invariants: Every physical entity has exactly one current location; a transfer has source release, supported transit and destination docking evidence.
IDs are unique and parent references form an acyclic graph; mixing/aliquoting retains mass or volume units and declared losses without creating stock.
Prepared Mat1 and Mat2 preserve separate component lots and recipe versions. A composite part retains both parents and its spatial region map.
Channel geometry records retain sacrificial ink, bath, needle and path parents; empty channel is a post-removal observation, not an input label.
Printed and cast manufacture routes cannot be relabelled. Hardness is printed; tensile is cast. Four hardness sites belong to one sample.
Destructive cure, sectioning and tensile testing change specimen state. Reusing a destroyed or cured aliquot requires a valid declared compatible use; new specimen identity is never invented.
Raw records are append-only, acquisition-linked and immutable. Derived records cite actual raw IDs and processing. Missing data are not zero.
Every retry references an earlier retained attempt and keeps its changed settings. Failed or late measurements are not deleted or promoted out of a fixed analysis set.
Projection, CAD and condition metadata are inputs. Source-reported outcomes, CAD dimensions and needle IDs are not measured episode values.
Current source main and SI contain no verified episode acquisition; all actual outputs require a real qualified environment record source.
A payload hash without an accessible actual acquisition payload is not sufficient; evaluator checks availability, integrity, context and units independently.
closure: Every allocated object and record has final location/status. Unfinished, consumed, failed, quarantined and waste states remain auditable.
